CATALOG_MGMT.DESCRIPTION: The products your team sends in conversations: photo, price and stock, all in one place.

LIST.EMPTY: No product here yet. Create one to start sending it in conversations.
LIST.ERROR: We could not load the catalog. Try again in a moment.

FORM.SAVE_ERROR: We could not save this product. Try again in a moment.
FORM.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load this product. Try again in a moment.

PHOTOS.LABEL: Product photos
PHOTOS.HINT: JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB. The first photo is the cover. 800x800 is recommended, which is the size WhatsApp shows.
PHOTOS.INVALID_TYPE: {name} is not a JPG or PNG file.
PHOTOS.REMOVE_ERROR: We could not remove this photo. Try again in a moment.

PUBLISH.TITLE: Publishing
PUBLISH.VISIBLE_HINT: Shows up for the agent to send
PUBLISH.FEATURED_HINT: Pins it to the top of the list

SYNC.TITLE: Sync
SYNC.QUEUED: Sync queued. This product stays pending until Meta confirms it.
SYNC.ERROR: We could not queue the sync. Try again in a moment.
SYNC.HIDDEN: Hidden products are removed from Meta on the next sync.

SYNC_ALL.QUEUED: Sync queued. Products update as Meta confirms them.
SYNC_ALL.ERROR: We could not queue the sync. Try again in a moment.

META_STATUS.PENDING_HINT: Goes to Meta on the next sync
META_STATUS.MISSING_HINT: Meta needs {items} to accept this product
